questions.prompt: Who is the healer in Harrogath?
questions.explanation: Malah welcomes travelers to 'the last stronghold of Order on Mount Arreat' and heals them there.

questions.prompt: What does Larzuk offer as the Siege on Harrogath reward?
choices: Personalizes an item with your name
questions.explanation: Larzuk adds sockets: up to 6 for white items based on ilvl, and 1 for rare/unique/set items.

questions.prompt: Where is Shenk the Overseer fought?
questions.explanation: Shenk the Overseer is slain in the Bloody Foothills to complete the Siege quest.

questions.prompt: Malah gives which Act V quest?
questions.explanation: Malah's Prison of Ice quest: she brews a potion to thaw Anya from the Frozen River.

questions.prompt: Where is Anya imprisoned by Nihlathak?
questions.explanation: Anya is frozen in the Frozen River; Malah's potion is needed to thaw her.

questions.prompt: Qual-Kehk holds which title in Harrogath?
questions.explanation: Qual-Kehk is Senior Man-At-Arms of Harrogath; he hires Barbarian mercenaries.

questions.prompt: Shenk the Overseer carries which modifier?
questions.explanation: Shenk is classified as an Overseer with the Extra Strong modifier.

questions.prompt: The Prison of Ice quest rewards you with a Scroll of Resistance that grants what?
questions.explanation: The Scroll of Resistance grants +10 to all resistances, alongside a rare class-specific item.

questions.prompt: What does Anya's Betrayal of Harrogath quest reward grant?
choices: Personalize an item with your name
Max sockets on a white item
questions.explanation: Anya personalizes one item by inscribing your character's name onto it.

questions.prompt: Larzuk is known for proposing wartime ideas centuries ahead of his time. Which are they?
questions.explanation: Larzuk proposes cannons and hot air balloons for warfare, earning him the reputation of a madman.

questions.prompt: Larzuk's socket service grants how many sockets to white (normal) items?
questions.explanation: White items receive 1-6 sockets based on their item level.

questions.prompt: How many sockets does Larzuk add to a rare, unique, or set item?
questions.explanation: Rare, unique, and set items get exactly 1 socket; only white items get the variable 1-6 roll.

questions.prompt: Qual-Kehk gives which two Act V quests?
choices: Siege on Harrogath and Prison of Ice
Rescue on Mount Arreat and Rite of Passage
Betrayal of Harrogath and Eve of Destruction
Prison of Ice and Eve of Destruction
questions.explanation: Qual-Kehk assigns Rescue on Mount Arreat and Rite of Passage (the Ancients).

questions.prompt: On Hell difficulty, Shenk the Overseer can drop which rune?
questions.explanation: Shenk's rune drops scale to Zod on Hell, making him a popular farm target.

questions.prompt: Rescuing Anya also unlocks which waypoint?
questions.explanation: Anya's rescue unlocks the Halls of Pain waypoint, the first step toward Nihlathak's Temple.
